content.short: Apibara is an open-source tool to stream and compose streams of on-chain data.
content.description: Apibara enables developers to stream on-chain data directly into their applications and power their backend infrastructure. By connecting to blockchain data sources, it supports a broad range of data types, including events, transactions, and storage changes, enabling teams to build real-time, scalable backends without having to manage data indexing themselves. With Apibara, you gain access to consistent, structured on-chain information across supported chains, letting you focus on application logic rather than data ingestion.
